Name: Dating Reversed
Author: beldavid1
Description:
You’ll see a 3-step dialogue:
a randomized warm-up line
a randomized follow-up line
a prompt: “Will you accept this bouquet?”
Choosing Yes shows a heart emote ❤️, you receive a Bouquet, and you are set to Dating with that NPC.
Choosing Not right now shows a tear emote 😢 and applies a short cooldown before anyone asks again. (this will count towards your seasonal limit)
Fully configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM), including gender filters, per-NPC toggles, monthly/seasonal limits, and cooldowns.


Requirements:
Stardew Valley 1.6+
SMAPI 4.0+
Generic Mod Config Menu 
(Recommended) Polyamory Sweet if you want more than 1 NPC to ask you out


Installation:
Install SMAPI.
Install Generic Mod Config Menu.
Download Dating Reversed and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
Launch the game with SMAPI.
 

Updating:
Replace the old mod folder with the new one.
It’s safe to update mid-save.


Uninstalling:
Delete the mod folder from Mods.
(Optional) Run the in-game console command "dr.clearall" to reset any mod data.


GMCM Configuration: 
Open GMCM from the title screen or the in-game menu (Options → Mod Options):
Enable Mod: Master on/off.
Max Bouquets Per Season: How many NPC confession events can happen per in-game season.
Random Cooldown: If on, the days before the next potential confession are random (1–9).
Fixed Cooldown (if random disabled): The exact number of cooldown days when Random Cooldown is off.
Allow Male Suitors / Allow Female Suitors: Filter by NPC gender.
Specific NPC Toggles: Enable/disable individual datable NPCs. *Must be in-game to see*
Changes to season limits and the NPC pool affect future event rolls. If you’re testing and want to force a new roll, use dr.clearcooldown or dr.forceevent <NPC>


How it works (under the hood):
Each morning, the mod picks at most one eligible NPC (not already dating you, ~8 hearts, allowed by filters, not on cooldown, and within the per-season cap).
When you leave your farmhouse onto the Farm (6:00–10:00), the event plays.
The “Yes” branch runs a safely pre-injected sub-event (emote ❤️, line, Bouquet, and status).
The “Not right now” branch is handled inline (emote 😢, line) and applies cooldown.
Multiplayer: Works for the host. Farmhands are ignored to avoid content race conditions.

Compatibility:
Stardew 1.6+ / SMAPI 4.0+: supported.
Should be compatible with most dialogue/relationship mods. Mods that replace Farm events wholesale could conflict.
Safe to add/remove mid-save.
Any and all NPCs from any mod should be compatible so long as they have the (single) status. Including datable Jodi, Robin, and Caroline.
This mod will let only 1 or all the single NPCs (Men and Women) ask you out assuming you have a multiple dating/marriage mod. 


Console Commands (debugging only):
[spoiler]
[list]
State & picking:dr.dumpstatus — Shows current pick, monthly count, and cooldown.dr.debugpool — Lists eligible right now.dr.explainpool — For every datable NPC, shows “OK” or the first reason they’re excluded (points, gender toggle, already dating, seen this month, etc.).dr.dumpids — How many datable NPCs the mod sees (useful for content-packs).dr.repick — Clears today’s pick & cooldown, then picks a new NPC immediately.Day/season:dr.clearcooldown — Clears today’s cooldown and pick (doesn’t change monthly count).dr.clearall — Full reset of this save’s DR data (daily pick, monthly counters, per-NPC monthly gates). Does not touch your save beyond that.Event control:dr.forceevent <NPC> — Force a specific NPC to be today’s proposer.dr.playevent — Plays today’s bouquet scene (auto-warps you to Farm and injects the event data if needed).Relationships:dr.setdating <NPC> / dr.unsetdating <NPC> — Toggle Dating for one NPC.dr.sethall <hearts 0–10> — Set all datable NPCs to the given hearts (e.g., dr.sethall 8 → 2000 pts, perfect for testing).dr.setpoints <NPC> <hearts|points> — Set one NPC to a heart value or raw points (e.g., dr.setpoints Emily 8 or dr.setpoints Emily 2000).dr.getpoints <NPC> — Print one NPC’s current points & status.[/list][/spoiler]


FAQs
Q: Do I have to give a Bouquet first?
A: No. This mod flips the script: NPCs can initiate and give you the bouquet.
Q: Can I limit who can ask?
A: Yes—by gender and per-NPC toggles in GMCM.
Q: My GMCM menu doesn’t show NPC toggles.
A: Load your save first. The per-NPC list populates in-game, not on the title screen.

Troubleshooting:
Q. I pressed Yes but nothing happened
A. Make sure GMCM is installed, and you loaded your save before testing (so the per-NPC setup is ready). If you’re testing repeatedly, run dr.clearcooldown first to remove any cooldown.
﻿
Q. No one ever asks me out
A. Ensure you’re ~8 hearts (2,000 friendship points), not already dating, and the NPC is enabled. Make sure you walk from Farmhouse onto Farm between 6:00–10:00 and that your Season cap in not reached.
